overview.description: The State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLCI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that provides US Communication Services sector exposure by investing in shares of the Communication Services Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLC). Additionally, it aims to provide income by selling short-dated call options. XLCI was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
